item.title: Friendship
item.description: “You can’t, they can only believe what their eyes can see. So for now be proud of what you got. Your soul knows and that’s enough. That’s what the medicine is for, so you need to find a way to protect it and when the time comes, bring them back to the source. Yes, it will be hard, cause for them to leave their egos behind, it may take them so many lives.
